change: Immutable sorted reaching-definition sets, shared singleton storage, a flat first-definition-site index, and one representative definition per pending use. CFG iteration, web ordering, copy-propagation order, search policy and proof gates are unchanged.
scope: Compiler analysis and emission costs. No runtime speedup is claimed: generated C and the native BLAKE3 compression object are byte-identical.

platform.limitations: Shared host heavily loaded, with uncontrolled frequency and scheduling. No builds or tests from this task overlapped timed runs. Full emission has only one before/after observation and is not a controlled compiler-speed estimate. CPU time and allocation counts are reported separately from wall time.

microbenchmarks.protocol: Frozen test binaries; sequential before-a, after-a, after-b, before-b process order. Each invocation uses five samples of three iterations per workload, giving ten samples per implementation. Webs excludes fixture lifting; SimplifyCopies includes lifting a cloned fixture and checks exactly 128 propagated and eliminated copies on every iteration.
